title: Advanced Referral Assessment
description: Evaluates how the student recognizes, explores, communicates, and manages concerns requiring consultation, referral, coordination, or escalation. Case-independent: all patient-specific grounding comes from the protected context of the selected case.
student_facing_description: Evaluates how you recognized the concern, explored it, respected professional boundaries, considered urgency and safety, and communicated next steps.

domains.title: Concern Recognition
domains.definition: Recognizes when patient information may require consultation, referral, coordination, or escalation beyond the current encounter.

domains.title: Relevant Exploration
domains.definition: Explores the concern sufficiently to understand its relevance, impact, and potential urgency.

domains.title: Professional Scope
domains.definition: Responds within appropriate professional boundaries and avoids unsupported diagnosis, prescription, or specialized treatment.

domains.title: Care Pathway Reasoning
domains.definition: Identifies a clinically reasonable next care pathway based on the information available.

domains.title: Urgency & Safety
domains.definition: Distinguishes routine coordination from prompt or immediate escalation.

domains.title: Patient-Centered Communication
domains.definition: Explains concerns and next steps respectfully, clearly, and collaboratively.

domains.title: Coordination & Follow-Up
domains.definition: Addresses documentation, supervision, communication, consent, referral follow-through, or expected next steps.
